$comment: Shared resources a git worktree cannot isolate. Tickets claim them in `resources:` frontmatter.

exclusive.DEPLOY: One Render service and one production Postgres: concurrent deploys, migrations or sandbox resets race each other.
exclusive.LOCK: package-lock.json and the root workspace config: two tickets adding dependencies at once produce conflicting lockfiles and a broken install. Claimed by tickets that add workspaces or many dependencies.
exclusive.SCHEMA: Drizzle schema and migration sequence: two concurrent migrations get conflicting numbers and a broken chain.

budgeted.LLM: Anthropic API spend under the $10/month cap. Workers iterate on recorded responses and spend real tokens only to prove an AC (≤ $1 per ticket).
